cases.title: Loft wall/stair occupancy
cases.interpretation: Independent stored raw-primitive/GEOS witnesses cover a full-width strip. No private images are reproduced.

cases.title: Farnsworth endpoint mismatch
cases.interpretation: A definite endpoint-on-room-floor failure, not a JSON or unknown-geometry failure.

cases.title: C03 identity and material scope
cases.interpretation: Internal stair identity is queried; only its material is outside the registered geometric scope. The external-stair connection is registered separately.

cases.title: Qwen landing support inconsistency
cases.interpretation: The field exists. Its value equals the box bottom, rather than its material top; the saved reader returns NOT_EVALUABLE/UNKNOWN.

cases.title: Astra zero-height landing
cases.interpretation: An executable-representation refusal, not proof that the intended physical interface is impossible.

cases.title: Slab equivalence counterexample
cases.interpretation: Only an encoding-sensitive alarm disappears. The full world remains VIOLATION and the fixed/registered primary results do not change.

cases.title: Positive San Xavier generated fragment
cases.interpretation: A positive for the bounded declared artifact and its covered target roles; no full-building, unseen-obstacle, or navigation certification.
